profile.headline: Sr  Software Engineer, Defense Systems & Critical Infrastructure at Rohde & Schwarz USA Inc.
profile.summary:
A veteran software developer with over 35 years' experience in all facets of the SDLC. Currently developing software applications and tools for RSA's Defense Systems & Critical Infrastructure division in Java, Python, C++ and C#.

While I was a member of the Telecommunications and Embedded Control System industries, I created a track record of successful project completions with high quality. I am highly motivated and a self-starter with experience working directly with end-users and customers to resolve problems. I am skilled in the implementation of X.25, BRI, PRI with a strong working knowledge of SIP, MGCP, MEGACO, TID, TARP, TL1 and CMIP using the C/C++ and PERL development languages. I am experienced with development for Unix, Linux, Microsoft Windows and pSOS. 

While part of the R&S EMS groups I built a real-time video analysis system aimed at customers who employed people to monitor camera feeds during immunity testing. The product called AdVISE, can monitor up to 32 regions of interest and monitor for changes in color, brightness, objects appearing or disappearing from a region of interest. In addition, the system can monitor flashing/blinking objects (a turn signal for example) to ensure that the rate remains within prescribed boundaries. AdVISE can also perform OCR on displays, including 7-segment displays, for textural information. This includes monitoring for known text information that may situationally dependent. AdVISE also supports the monitoring of rotating object notifying the user of when a rotating object starts, stops and if the rate is outside of known limits. AdVISE is built on Windows 10/11 using WPF and a combination of Computer vision and ML/DL. This work has allowed me to be granted one US Patent (US-10663505-B2) and one European Patent (EP3809687A1).

Specialties: 
- 18 years development in C/C++ and PERL, 3 years in C#/AJAX, 15+ years of C#/.NET, 3 years JAVA and 3 years Python
- Front office and back office
- Unix, Linux, Windows and pSOS.
- X.25, BRI, PRI, SIP, MGCP and MEGACO, EB200. 
- 7+ years development of soft switches and media gateways.
- 5+ year working in Computer Vision and ML/DL/AI
- Exp'd Mgr of Hardware Labs, Development and System Test groups.
- Experience working w/ customers during all phases of the product life cycle.
- Developed and managed Operating Expense and Capitol Budgets >$1M.
- In depth knowledge of Solaris 9 and 10, Ubuntu Linux 18.04, 20.04 and 22.02, RHEL, Windows 7, 10 and 11
- Experience with git and GitLab, CI/CD

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Project Mgr. and Product Mgr for AdVISE
positions.description: AdVISE is a real-time video analysis system for devices under test in an EMC chamber. The system can accept multiple video streams and process each from looking for user specified changes of the equipment under test. The system can also be used in a non-EMC environment to observe anything that a human operator can observe. My duties include, System Architecture, Software Design, Coding, marketing and sales support, installation support and post sales support.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Project Mgr., Product Mgr.
positions.description: Design and implementation of custom software in C#/.NET 4 in support of R&S' Systems Group high power RF systems for EMC testing. My Project Manager duties include assisting our RF project managers with assembly, test, installation and on site SAT testing as well as coordinating software projects meant to provide system control or data analysis for our EMC customer. Product Manager for a HD video based system to provide automated analysis of devices under RF fields up to 200v/m.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Sr. Software Engineer creating custom software tools and applications for our EMC customers. I also am working with one of our Munich development teams to create extensions and device drivers for our EMC32 product. My development is primarily in Visual Studio 2010 using WPF and National Instruments Measurement Studio 2012.  Traveling extensively, which I enjoy, I have had the opportunity to spend time on installations and performing code modifications on customer sites. I continue to work hard at bringing my skills in RF and Microwave radiation applications to a higher level

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a .NET/AJAX web application to manage log in instructions and access methods for all of Ericsson's 300+ customers. This application is used by all of Ericsson's Customer Network Support engineers in RNAM (Region North America) to rapidly obtain the necessary information to log into a particular piece of equipment at a particular customer site. The app uses Windows Authentication to help provide single sign on and includes role based functionality.

The app is build using Visual Studio 2010, .NET 4.0 and the Telerik .NET AJAX toolkit.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Contract Software Engineer in the Proactive Support group. Part of a group charged with gathering data and information from Ericsson network devices to support a proactive approach to customer service. Currently creating Web based tools for internal use by the North American division of Ericsson. Development being done in Visual Studio 2010 and using the Rad ASP.NET controls from Telerik.

positions.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER
positions.description:
Spearheaded team responsible for porting C3 to new Sun CMT based hardware and Solaris 10. This evolution required an in depth analysis of C3 software architecture and Solaris 10 kernel tuning with respect to a new class of microprocessor.
Assisted Sun Microsystems in the analysis of a Solaris 10 TCP/IP device driver problem. Specifically Layer 2 and Layer 3 interaction as well as the interrupt handler to clear up a locked up TCP/IP port at high traffic levels.
Responsible for the C3 Media Gateway Controller Emergency recovery CD based on Solaris Jump Start. This required an in depth knowledge of Solaris boot up process and procedures.
Responsible for C3 development group Jumpstart server.
Redesigned and implemented new development network consisting of 8 development servers running Solaris 10 and making use of newer file system technologies (ZFS), compilers (Sun Studio 12) and tools improving productivity.
Continued responsibility for the C3 development lab including supervising installation of media gateways, media gateway controllers running Solaris 8, 9 or 10, network configuration and IP assignment, load configuration and physical plant 
Tools used: Jumpstart, Solaris 8, 9 & 10, Solaris Studio 11, DTrace, GNU C++ compiler, SMF, pkgproto, pkgadd, pkgmk, Sun OBP, Networking, NIS, NFS, DNS, cron/crontab, CMT T2000, Sun 440, Sun 240, ZFS, Disk Array, PERL
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Debugging · Establishing Priorities · Attention to Detail · Unix · Sensitive Information · Industry standards · English · Linux · Diplomacy · Communication

positions.title: Lab Manager/Release Coordinator
positions.description: As part of the GPS current engineering group for the Santera/Tekelec T9000 I am responsible for all the hardware and software for all of the group's T9000 switches. My duties also extend to coordinating with the various other departments our releases. I also have responsibility for managing a Capital Budget of $1M+. This included creating the budget, handling all purchasing activities and tracking capital and expense items.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Establishing Priorities · Unix · English · Diplomacy · Communication

positions.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER
positions.description:
Team Lead for multiple software development teams consisting of 4 to 8 people tasked with development of new features (C++, XML, PERL) for the Tekelec T3000 soft switch real time embedded software running under Solaris. This required coordinating between T8000 Media Gateway hardware and software development, Systems Engineering, PLM and System Test.
Created and published schedules. Reported weekly status to management
Developed code (C++) for the Facilities Manager application for new PRI features
Created a special simulator/test system (C++) using Linux (Redhat) based PC and a Dialogic PCI card to test a ROSE PRI feature. Because of the nature of the feature had to bypass the normal API and manually encode/decode all PRI messages at the layer 3 level. Also encoded/decoded ASN.1 messages embedded in PRI datagrams. The test application was written based on the appropriate Bellcore and AT&T/Lucent specifications as well as ITU X-219, X-229 and ITU X.680.
Tools used: Solaris 8, 9 & 10, Solaris Studio 11, GNU C++ compiler, pkgproto, pkgadd, pkgmk, Signal Generators, Protocol Analyzers, Network analyzers/ Sniffers, Call Generators, DevTrack, Purify, Quantify, Source Level Debuggers, RedHat Linux, RPM, Dialogic ISDN Card, Development tools

positions.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, coding and unit test of real time embedded software (C++) running under Solaris for the VXi Media Gateway Controller.
Primary focus was signaling protocols (PRI, SIP and MEGACO) for the VXi media gateway controller. Coding and unit testing was conducted to specifications: by ITU Q.921, Q.931, ETSI PRI, QSIG, H.248 and H.323
Worked closely with Systems Engineering, customers and partners developing requirements for features ensuring traceability throughout coding and testing.
Handled systems integration efforts for the group including stress testing and system tuning.
Tools used: Solaris 8, 9 & 10, Solaris Studio 9 & 10, GNU C++ compiler, Signal Generators, Protocol Analyzers, Network analyzers/ Sniffers, Call Generators, Purify, Quantify, Source Level Debuggers
.
Manager, VXi System

Managed daily activities of six test engineers
Interfaced with customers and partners, prepared schedules and reported to senior management on all facets of system test.
Grew the group from 2 to 6 test engineers, increasing test coverage and reducing test cycle time
Tools used: Solaris * & 9, MS Access, MS Project, Signal Generators, Protocol Analyzers, Network analyzers/ Sniffers, Call Generators

positions.description:
Part of team assigned to Fujitsu to assist in the development ("C") of the control software for their new FLASH-192 SONET product running pSOS on proprietary hardware.
